call_input.prompt:
Edit the supplied immediate parent poster. This is own repair-1 of the same R6-C2-M3 square design; not another variant.

Actual self-inspected defects to fix:
1. Upper-right EXCHANGE is disproportionately condensed compared with OBJECT and NAME. Use the same natural-width bold letterform construction throughout all three English words; fit the longest word by adjusting the entire English title's size and spacing rather than squeezing its horizontal shape. Rebalance the Korean title modestly only if necessary so both language titles remain equivalent reading surfaces.
2. The orange binder clip touches/covers the lower-left part of the first E in EXCHANGE. Give a clear gap between all letters and the object. Make the same orange binder clip smaller and place it crossing the center seam in the available space between title pair and event time. Preserve recognizable folded orange body, curved reflective metal handles, coherent lighting and restrained shadow. Do not create additional handles, body panels or repeated objects.
3. Give the bottom deadline slightly more line spacing, allowing a sensible wrap if needed, while retaining the comfortably large full URL and other body text.

Preserve: the exact two equal lime/periwinkle surfaces, deep navy text, center seam, one orange binder clip, matching language-title roles, full complete supplied body copy, strong contrast, substantial lower information area and square opaque canvas. Do not add effects or labels. The clip must not overlap ANY printed text. Text should retain natural uncompressed proportions.

Full original request, copy and mandatory conditions follow; these remain binding:
Create exactly ONE finished flat square poster, no mockup, no contact sheet. Role R6-C2-M3 is the one square member of the requested series. Opaque background. Use case: ads-marketing.

Original user request (preserve its intent and all supplied text):
아래 내용으로 덕테이프 포스터 5장 부탁해. 물건을 가져와 서로 이름을 바꿔 보는 가상 행사야. 제목만 멋있게 보이기보다 준비물·제외 조건·참가 방법까지 휴대폰 화면에서 읽히게 만들어줘. 세로 2:3 두 장, 세로 4:5 두 장, 정사각형 한 장으로 나눠줘. 문구는 그대로 쓰고 추가 문구나 QR코드는 넣지 마. 아래 URL은 포스터용 가상 주소이니 실제 접수나 링크 방문은 하지 마.

Exact complete printed copy, each string appears exactly once, no substitutions, omissions, translations, added labels or invented object names:
이름 바꾸는 물건들
OBJECT NAME EXCHANGE
2026.11.21(토) 13:30–16:00
가상 공간 여울실험실 2층 / YEOUL LAB
한국어·English, 어느 언어로 적어도 좋아요.
이름을 바꾸고 싶은 작은 물건 1개를 가져오세요.
깨지기 쉬운 물건과 음식은 받지 않아요.
만 16세 이상 · 무료 · 24명
11.18(수) 18:00까지 아래 주소로 참가 의사를 남겨주세요.
yeoul.example/NAME?lang=ko&slot=pm

Mandatory conditions:
전체 10개 문자열을 모두 정확히 보존한다. 새 소제목·가짜 라벨 내용·장식 문자·QR코드를 추가하지 않는다.
휴대폰 화면에서 준비물·제외 조건·참가 대상·마감·URL까지 읽혀야 한다. 작은 하단 띠에 나머지 카피를 몰지 않는다.
행사의 핵심은 실제 물건을 가져와 이름을 바꾸어 보는 참여다. 물건은 특정 브랜드 없이 단순하고 견고한 작은 생활 물건으로 표현한다.
이름표나 사전 같은 시각 장치를 쓸 때 제공 문구를 배치하거나 무문자로 두며, 새 물건 이름·번역·로고·미세 문자를 발명하지 않는다.
가상 주소는 표시만 한다. 외부 접수나 URL 방문을 하지 않는다.
The whole series has two 2:3, two 4:5, and one 1:1 poster; generate only this 1:1 member.

Assigned art direction:
서로 다른 언어로 이름을 적을 수 있다는 조건을 두 읽는 면과 그 사이를 건너는 물건으로 나타낸다.
가까운 방향과 구분할 관계: M2는 사람 사이 교환을 중심에 둔다. M3은 두 언어의 동등한 읽는 면과 그 사이의 물건이 중심이며 제목 두 개의 역할도 대응이다.

Concrete design:
Make two equal upright reading planes side by side across the square. Left is pale acid-lime, right is muted periwinkle; deep navy typography. A clean narrow central seam joins the planes. This should feel like two equal naming surfaces, not a conventional hero image plus tiny footer. The Korean title occupies upper left with deliberate three-line grouping '이름 / 바꾸는 / 물건들'; the English title occupies upper right in three corresponding lines 'OBJECT / NAME / EXCHANGE'. The two titles have equivalent visual importance and open, sturdy letterforms. Keep Korean glyphs natural and English letters uncompressed, with generous margins.
One recognizable small unbranded orange binder clip, carefully rendered in simple crisp physical form, crosses the center seam beneath the title pair. Its bent metal handles and orange body have coherent geometry and restrained light. It is the sole pictorial subject; no people, duplicate objects, arrows, flourishes, logos or labels. The object crossing the two surfaces visualizes exchanging an object's name between two languages.
Allocate the lower roughly 58 percent of the square to the eight remaining exact strings, using carefully aligned, generously spaced information groups with large readable type. The event time and venue form one group; language and what to bring form the next; exclusion and eligibility another; deadline and full URL form the last. They may cross the central seam within a shared calm reading grid and wrap only at meaningful word spaces. All mandatory details must remain plainly legible at 720px total poster width. The lower information area is substantial, not a narrow footer, and the full URL should be prominent enough to read, with exactly uppercase NAME, '?lang=ko&slot=pm', and no spaces inside it. The longest deadline sentence must have enough width or two comfortable lines; do not horizontally squash it. Use no extra headings, icons, bullet glyphs or ornament.
Flat clean color fields, careful optical alignment, natural Hangul internal spaces, consistent stroke weights. Avoid paper-grain overlays, fake microtext, generic tech decoration, indiscriminate textures and shadows.
Requested ratio exactly 1:1. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
